card.name: Words in descriptions of violent assault
card.fires_on: Words right after or inside a description of beating, torture, rape or killing, such as adverbs, commas in lists of abuses, and 'the' before 'incident'. Seen in human rights reports and crime news.

modes.label: Adverb or verb of violence
modes.description: Words like brutally, severely or stabbed that modify or describe a beating or attack on a victim.
modes.example: After being kidnapped, she was<< brutally>> beaten, raped, and killed.

modes.label: Commas and links in lists of abuses
modes.description: Commas or small words inside a list of violent acts, where the next item is another abuse.
modes.example: After being kidnapped, she was brutally beaten<<,>> raped, and killed.

modes.label: Link before torture or injury
modes.description: A small word like 'to' or 'the' just before a named torture or incident.
modes.example: many more were subjected<< to>> torture, rape, and dog attacks.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward violence terms like attack or escape.
card.plain: It lights up in reports of beatings, torture and killings, as the text moves toward the next violent act.
